vb_textbox.text: I think this is a great and simple game for all ages to enjoy. I like the fact that not only adults can understand the concept but also small children can as there are only three keys to use. I would make the game more interesting by adding harder levels into the same. One suggestion would be maybe introducing using the left and right keys to move the basket across with falling mushrooms to try and catch as many in the basket. This could be a harder level or a bonus level. I do feel like there should be other levels/backgrounds or characters involved to keep your audience interested in the game.However i feel like the concept is great, well done!
